notes:
Original primary PDF verified independently, not replaced by values quoted in replication. Original prints p < 0.009; replication table quotes original as p = .009, which was not substituted. Replication locator p.10 presents expanded 2 × 4 interaction F(3,1827) = 0.56, p = .644, with 1835 retained participants; those statistics include ingroup/outgroup extension levels and are not the identified-versus-unidentified target specified in the description. Matching 2 × 2 target is separately printed in p.6 Table 2 and discussed in section 3.1.4. Printed partial eta squared for matching replication is 0.00; requested F statistic retained. Analytic sample supplied as printed cell counts; no generic eight-condition N substituted. Cache provenance: frozen supplied replication parse verified against publisher title and newly fetched primary PDF.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 4 gives final counts for the four mutually exclusive replication conditions. The direct-replication subsection explicitly identifies their 2 × 2 ANOVA; Results states analyses follow pre-registered exclusions. The 1835 total includes extension groups. Detailed exclusion criteria are in unavailable Supplementary Table S17.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Evaluation criteria and mirrored-design subsection establish the target interaction. Table 5 H3 prints partial eta-squared 0.00 for the replication, with same-test p = .666. Retain this printed metric despite requested test statistic. F for the direct 2 × 2 interaction is not visible in the incomplete Table 2 parse; referred Supplementary Table S21 is not supplied. No conversion performed.
